title: Understanding the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix X is constructed with rows representing individuals' lunches and columns representing the number of servings of each food item. Each column corresponds to a specific food item.

title: Interpreting Coefficients
text: In a linear regression model, the coefficient for a feature represents the change in the response variable for a one-unit change in that feature, holding all other features constant.

title: Relating Coefficients to Calories
text: Since the features represent servings of food, the coefficient for a food item represents the typical calories per serving of that food.

hintAnswer: Typical calories consumed through food j per serving size
title: Identify the Correct Interpretation
text: What does the optimal coefficient \( \hat{\theta}_j \) represent in terms of calories and servings?
choices: Typical calories consumed through food j per day
Typical calories consumed through food j per serving size
Typical calories consumed by person j per day
Typical calories consumed by person j per serving size
